jobs.title: About us
jobs.description: About - Travelier About us Our brands Partners Research In the press Careers Contact & locations Unforgettable journeys powered by technology. Travelier is the largest group for ground and sea transportation. The last undigitized sector in travel When you book a ﬂight or a hotel, you know exactly what’s in store. As for booking rides on the journey, no such luck. There are long lines to contend with, confusing ferry schedules, old buses with springs popping out of the seats. It’s enough to make you wish you’d just get to your destination. Along comes Travelier. The company that channels passion for all things travel by bridging local transportation providers with modern, tech-savvy travelers. Travelier is the seamless way to book any mode of transportation across the globe with 5 global online brands serving over 120 countries worldwide. Facts and figures: 80% More than 80% of transportation bookings worldwide are purchased oﬄine, while 80% of ﬂight bookings are made through online channels. $198B Total addressable market out of $2 Trillion in the travel industry. 14M Monthly visitors on all of the Travelier platforms. 150 Operators worldwide work and trust Travelier’s TMS (transportation management system) brands. From inventory to customer experience, we breathe travel Technology Digitizing the last fragmented industry in travel. Local Growing transportation businesses in developing countries. Travel Making memorable journeys for travelers around the world. Centralizing Building the largest ground and sea transportation inventory hub. How our journey started In 2016, during his honeymoon in the Philippines, Noam Toister, one of our Co-Founders and CEO, encountered challenges in ﬁnding transportation options to visit the rice ﬁelds in Banaue. Despite his eﬀorts to navigate cultural barriers and obtain ride information, he faced the additional hurdle of having to travel an hour to the bus station to purchase a ticket, only to discover that the bus was not departing until the following day. This experience sparked Noam’s entrepreneurial spirit, leading him to create a simple website that sold bus tickets online to the same route in the Philippines. As the idea gained traction, Noam and Co-Founders, Omer Chehmer and David Yitzhaki, recognized the demand for an online travel company that could streamline transportation options around the world. Today, our company has evolved to provide travelers with a comprehensive suite of travel-related services, leveraging innovative technology to enhance the customer experience and transform the travel industry. | Follow us on LinkedIn Founders Noam Toister – CEO Travelier Omer Chehmer – COO Travelier David Itzhaki – CSO Travelier Investors Our core values Foundations for our journey together Travel Fanatics The very idea of travel excites us and inspires us. We breathe, know and love everything about travel. Succeed together Whether it’s with our colleagues, suppliers, global guilds, we work as a team and help each other. We know that every individual or local success contributes to our larger goal as a group. Figure it out We don’t see walls, but rather smart solutions. We use critical thinking, we act, we change, we don’t take no for an answer. We take full ownership and are accountable for our actions. It’s in our DNA to say “yes, let’s find a way….” Obsessed with Data All opinions matter but we make decisions based on data. We use data for everything. Yes, everything. We quantify, we on things that can be tracked and measured. | Read our full culture guide Travelier Home About Our brands Partners Media Careers Contact | Bookaway About Careers Partners Blog | 12Go About Careers Aﬃliate program Partners | Plataforma10 About Careers Blog | DeOnibus About Careers | Traveling.com Careers Bus Companies Blog | Sisorg About Clients | SeatOS Back to top

Bookaway’s mission is to help people experience the liberation of travel and enjoy the ride. As one of the world’s largest and fastest growing ground transportation marketplaces for both established and local operators alike, Bookaway enables operators of all sizes around the world to reach a global audience and to grow their businesses. Bookaway oﬀers more than 22,000 transfers in nearly 2,000 cities in over 100 countries around the world. 13 Languages 90 Employees 1.2k Operators | 12go From its beginnings as a small e-commerce startup in 2012, 12Go has grown to offer a global network of transportation options in destinations worldwide, offering travelers easy access to a wide variety of luxury and budget buses, ferries, trains and flights. Incorporated and headquartered in Singapore, 12Go is available in 20 different languages, enabling them to continuously work toward their goal of making both leisure and business travel easily accessible for everyone, no matter where in the world they are or what language they speak. 20 Languages 136 Employees 10K Operators | Plataforma10 Connecting more than 15,000 destinations across Argentina, Brazil, Bolivia, Chile, Paraguay, Peru and Uruguay with their innovative technology, training methods and products, Plataforma 10 offers 22 years of experience in the industry and has grown to become a major player in the digital world. The company enables travelers to book tickets at face value either online or at one of its physical service centers located all around Argentina and Paraguay. 15K Cities 104 Employees 500 Operators | DeÔnibus Founded by brothers Breno Moraes and Mariana Malveira, more than 12 years ago, DeÔnibus is one of the main bus travel marketplaces in Brazil. The company has served more than 7 million travelers in Brazil and also acts as a technological partner for many bus companies, bus stations and travel agencies across the country. 300 Operators 80% Geographical coverage 30M Visitors per year | Traveling.com Traveling.com is the ultimate online platform for booking bus, ferry, train, and transfer tickets worldwide. jobs.title: Research
jobs.description: Research - Travelier About us Our brands Partners Research In the press Careers Contact & locations Research The State of Ground and Sea Transportation 2024 Skift x Travelier, December 18, 2024 Intercity transportation including buses, ferries, trains, and transfers—remains one of the most overlooked yet high-potential segments in the global travel industry. Valued at $198 billion, this sector is ripe for digital disruption, especially as much of the travel industry’s innovation has historically centered on flights and accommodation. In this insights report, Travelier and Skift unveil the first comprehensive market sizing of this dynamic space. Based on exclusive research conducted by Skift Advisory in May 2024, the deck highlights emerging digital trends, signals of consolidation, and the vast opportunity awaiting travel brands, intermediaries, and investors who are ready to build a seamless end-to-end travel journey. The integration brings one of the world’s most fragmented transportation ecosystems into AI-powered travel discovery, powered by 12Go’s network of more than 20,000 local operators across 140+ markets. The launch reinforces Travelier ’s broader mission of making regional ground and sea transportation globally discoverable, accessible, and bookable through modern digital infrastructure. | Read more #Travelier The Hidden Infrastructure Behind Overtourism As destinations push travelers beyond overcrowded hotspots, the next challenge is no longer demand – but accessibility. Our CEO Noam Toister shares his view on how fragmented ground and sea transportation infrastructure limits tourism dispersal, and why digitizing buses, ferries, rail, and regional transport networks could become one of the most important solutions shaping the future of global travel. | Read more #Traveling.com Travelier launches Traveling.com to lead ground & sea travel in Europe Formerly GetByBus the brand reintroduces itself in Europe After more than a decade connecting travellers across Croatia and Southeast Europe through the GetByBus platform, the company is entering a new era. The rebrand to Traveling.com reflects into transition to a global, multi-modal travel platform designed to simplify how people move across borders, islands and regions. Traveling.com becomes the group’s new flagship consumer brand in Europe, consolidating previously separate offerings GetByBus, GetByFerry, GetByTransfer and the GetBy App, into one platform. | Read more #Travelier Taking inspiration from Amazon’s Full-Stack approach Becoming “the Amazon of” any industry is the ambition of many businesses in many verticals. jobs.title: Junior Supply Operation Specialist (Bangkok-based) Bangkok, Thailand Supply Operations
jobs.description: We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Junior Supply Operations Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operators and suppliers after deals are signed, ensuring seamless day-to-day operations, updates, and coordination. You will collaborate closely with the Supply Business Development team, as well as cross-functional teams including Customer Support, Product, and Finance, to deliver a smooth and reliable supplier experience. Your work will be essential to maintaining strong supplier relationships, ensuring operational excellence, and quickly resolving any issues that arise – all while optimizing content, pricing, and availability across our platform.Responsibilities:Supplier Relationship Management – Act as the main operational contact for suppliers, providing ongoing support and maintaining open communication channels.Operational Execution & Maintenance – Manage day-to-day updates to supplier contracts, routes, and systems, including enabling/disabling services as needed.Issue Resolution & Escalation – Own the resolution of technical or operational challenges; collaborate with internal teams to troubleshoot and resolve backend or system issues.SLA & Booking Monitoring – Track booking statuses and system-generated processes to ensure full SLA compliance and timely service delivery.Manual Adjustments & Reconciliations – Handle manual updates to bookings, correct inventory discrepancies, and ensure financial accuracy in coordination with our finance team.Content & Workflow Management – Support suppliers in maintaining accurate and appealing content (descriptions, images, rates), and ensure internal SOPs and workflows remain updated and aligned with process changes.Availability & Pricing Optimization – Collaborate with suppliers to keep availability and pricing up to date and competitive.Support Integration – Respond to inquiries from internal teams (e.g., Customer Support via Zendesk or Slack), particularly when coordination with suppliers is required.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.location: Ramat Gan, Tel Aviv District, IL
jobs.description: Travelier, formerly known as Bookaway Group, is a travel-tech company, revolutionizing ground and sea transportation for travelers. Travelier’s network of digital platforms allow customers to instantly buy intercity tickets to ferries, buses and trains in local markets which can be usually complex, enabling stress-free travel across the globe. ﻿What will you be doing?Handling legal aspects of commercial transactions, including licensing, distribution, cooperation, affiliation, and others (drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a broad range of agreements).Overseeing corporate compliance in multiple jurisdictions in the Travelier group, and supporting day-to-day corporate governance and company secretarial matters.Interact and work with the group's departments (sales, purchasing, Human Resources, R&D, operations and finance) on diverse legal issues in different jurisdictions.Collaborate with, advise, and support cross-functional internal and external teams on a wide variety of legal matters relating to the company’s day-to-day operations, including compliance and corporate governance in multiple jurisdictions.Advising on day-to-day employment matters (employment agreements/social benefits) in various jurisdictions.Partnering with various corporate teams, including supply, global finance, tax, M&A, operations, support, and business functions to implement various international corporate subsidiary projects.Engaging with external legal counsels.

Monetize your content by recommending 450,000+ routes to your audience. Join Us Why join the 12Go travel affiliate program? High affiliate commissions: earn 50% revenue share Instant access to 450,000+ routes 30-day cookie window Easy-to-use tools like search boxes, timetables, white labels, banners, and more Helpful support Convenient real-time reporting Getting started is easy Register Sign up for free and get access to promotional materials and reporting. Install our tools Setting up 12Go promotional tools is very easy. From ticket search forms to handy timetable widgets and engaging banners, we’ve got many options for you to choose from. Generate revenue Earn 50% revshare for every booking made by your referrals during the 30-day cookie window. Keep track of your earnings in the real-time dashboard reports. We’re here for you Affiliate blog Our affiliate blog is your go-to hub for 12Go news and updates, tools information, and the latest top route trends. See how to maximize your earnings and stay in the loop with updates. Visit blog → Contact support Need assistance with affiliate tools, have a question about the program, or just want to say hello? Just send us an email or submit a contact form to connect with our friendly affiliate support. Contact us → FAQ What types of transport are on 12Go’s travel affiliate program? Trains, buses, ferries, flights, vans, taxis, you name it - 12Go covers all types of transportation, and they are all available in the affiliate program. How are the bookings tracked? After the registration, you will get your unique partner ID. Once a visitor has followed your tracking link, we save your ID code into the cookies of the visitor’s web browser and keep it for 30 days. You'll get the commission if this customer books a ticket on 12go within the cookie lifetime (30 days). How long does a cookie last? Cookies are stored for 30 days and work on a last-click basis. All the bookings made within 30 days by the user who clicked on your affiliate link will be credited to you. Even if the user closes the website and opens it again from a search engine, you still get credit for all the bookings. After 30 days, the cookie will expire, and the user won't be linked to the partner anymore. If the user clicks a link from another partner after yours, the credit goes to the last partner. How are the payouts made? 12Go travel affiliate program offers a few payout options: Paypal, Wise, and direct transfer. You can check your balance in real-time in the affiliate dashboard. The minimum payout via Paypal and Wise is just 300 THB (or equivalent in another currency). The minimum payout via bank transfer is 33,000 THB or equivalent in another currency. In which currency do you make payouts? You have the option to receive payouts through PayPal in Thai Baht (THB), US Dollars (USD), Euros (EUR), British Pounds (GBP), Singapore Dollars (SGD), and Australian Dollars (AUD). Alternatively, if you choose Wise as your payout method, you can receive payments in Thai Baht (THB), US Dollars (USD), Australian Dollars (AUD), Canadian Dollars (CAD), Euros (EUR), Hungarian Forints (HUF), British Pounds (GBP), New Zealand Dollars (NZD), and Singapore Dollars (SGD). Bank payouts can be done in Thai Baht (THB), US Dollars (USD), and Euros (EUR). Who can join the 12Go travel affiliate program? You're a great fit for our program if you run a travel website or blog, own social media community with travel-related content, or have an online travel agency. If you sell travel services offline, please check our resellers program . How much can I earn? We give our partners 50% of the total profit. The average commission is $3 per booking. Do I need a website to join the affiliate program? No, having a website is not a requirement. You can join and share affiliate links on your social media accounts. However, we may ask you for proof of ownership. What tools are available for the promotion? 12Go has a variety of available instruments: easy-to-integrate deep-links, search form, timetable, banners, white label, and more complex solutions like data feeds and API. You can easily set up links and search forms without technical expertise. It's a task that takes just a few minutes to complete. What if I have several websites? Do I need to create separate accounts for all of them? You can have multiple websites and incorporate affiliate links on each of them. All the bookings will be tracked under the same affiliate account. If you want to differentiate which website the booking is coming from, you can set up sub-ID tracking. Add the sub-ID at the end of the links, and then you'll be able to see different websites in the bookings report. How do I contact you? You can fill out the contact form to open a support case or send us an email at affiliate@12go.asia. Can I use your API? If you have an established website and want access to the API functionality, please contact us and let us know about the planned project. Our team will guide you through the process. How will I know if my application is accepted? If your application to join the program has been approved, you will receive an email from us with the sign-in instructions. You can contact us anytime to inquire about the status of the application or if you have any other questions. Where can I find Affiliate Terms and Conditions? Terms and Conditions are accessible from the affiliate dashboard sidebar, or you can visit this link . How to delete a 12Go affiliate account? You will find a profile delete button on the profile and settings screen in the affiliate dashboard. Does it cost anything to join? Absolutely not! jobs.title: Business Development Manager (Ha Noi) Vietnam Business Development
jobs.description: We are seeking a results-driven Business Development Manager to lead Travelier’s supply growth strategy across a defined region or operator portfolio. In this high-impact role, you’ll be responsible for driving revenue, optimizing performance, and building lasting partnerships that position Travelier as a leader in ground transportation.You’ll manage the full business development cycle—from market research and lead generation to contract negotiations and ongoing partner optimization—while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure supplier success.Responsibilities:Supply Growth & Strategy – Identify and pursue new partnership opportunities, expanding our supply network across key markets and increasing volume with existing partners.End-to-End Ownership – Lead all stages of the partner lifecycle, including outreach, negotiation, onboarding, and ongoing relationship management.Commercial & Contractual Execution – Drive pricing and terms discussions, manage contract execution, and support operational setup.Market Analysis – Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, and local dynamics to inform business strategy and drive informed decisions.Performance Monitoring – Track and analyze partner metrics such as availability, rates, and coverage to ensure strong market representation and performance.Cross-Team Collaboration – Work closely with internal teams (Operations, Content, Finance, Marketing, Product) to ensure seamless execution and aligned go-to-market strategies.

jobs.title: Junior Supply Operation Specialist - Philippines Bangkok, Thailand Supply Operations
jobs.description: We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Junior Supply Operations Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operators and suppliers after deals are signed, ensuring seamless day-to-day operations, updates, and coordination. You will collaborate closely with the Supply Business Development team, as well as cross-functional teams including Customer Support, Product, and Finance, to deliver a smooth and reliable supplier experience. Your work will be essential to maintaining strong supplier relationships, ensuring operational excellence, and quickly resolving any issues that arise – all while optimizing content, pricing, and availability across our platform.Responsibilities:Supplier Relationship Management – Act as the main operational contact for suppliers, providing ongoing support and maintaining open communication channels.Operational Execution & Maintenance – Manage day-to-day updates to supplier contracts, routes, and systems, including enabling/disabling services as needed.Issue Resolution & Escalation – Own the resolution of technical or operational challenges; collaborate with internal teams to troubleshoot and resolve backend or system issues.SLA & Booking Monitoring – Track booking statuses and system-generated processes to ensure full SLA compliance and timely service delivery.Manual Adjustments & Reconciliations – Handle manual updates to bookings, correct inventory discrepancies, and ensure financial accuracy in coordination with our finance team.Content & Workflow Management – Support suppliers in maintaining accurate and appealing content (descriptions, images, rates), and ensure internal SOPs and workflows remain updated and aligned with process changes.Availability & Pricing Optimization – Collaborate with suppliers to keep availability and pricing up to date and competitive.Support Integration – Respond to inquiries from internal teams (e.g., Customer Support via Zendesk or Slack), particularly when coordination with suppliers is required.
